newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hutchison down on Subic Bay worries.
newsitem.headline: Hutchison down on Subic Bay worries.

text.p: Shares of Hutchison Whampoa Ltd were hit on Tuesday by news that its Subic Bay project was under review by Philippine government, brokers said.
The stock was down HK$1.10 at HK$47.10 in early afternoon trade, with 2.6 million shares traded.

A legal advisor to Philippine President Fidel Ramos said Ramos has stepped into a row over the Subic Bay project after International Container Terminal Services Inc appealed to the Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority to reverse its decision to award the port contract to Hutchison.

"Investors are taking the news as an excuse to unload the shares but a further slide is unlikely in view of the relatively low turnover," said an institutional sales manager with a major local brokerage.

Brokers said investors feared Hutchison's earnings prospects may be hit if the company failed to secure the contract. Disappointing interim earnings also dampened sentiment, they said. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
